title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026 GE Vernova reported 266.3 million shares outstanding, USD 13.1 billion cash, USD 2.794 billion long-term borrowings, USD 9.897 billion first-half free cash flow, and 270 million Q2 diluted weighted-average shares.
summary: The SEC-filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q confirms strong Power and Electrification demand and cash generation, while identifying working-capital dependence, Wind execution, tariffs, capacity investment, acquisition integration, and backlog-conversion risks.
